description.en: The colour of these tourmalines changes with the light between a mysterious grey and a celestial blue. Combined with the soft shimmer of white pearls and the warm glow of gold 900 - a festive dream!  They can be made with other precious gems and pearls, too. Please contact me, together we will create your personal favo
